title: Determining if Property is Exempt under sec. 70.11
summary: General decision tree for property tax exemption under sec. 70.11: annual review of exempt property, owner inquiry, Property Tax Exemption Request (Form PR-230) March 1 filing, and whether the property meets exemption requirements under specific state law.
disclaimer: This flow chart provides general information and may not apply in every situation. A thorough review of each property is still required.
router_description: Determining if property is exempt under sec. 70.11. General decision tree for property tax exemption eligibility, Property Tax Exemption Request form PR-230, exemption review, March 1 filing deadline.
notes: Presumption of taxability: sec. 70.109 provides that exemptions shall be strictly construed with a presumption that the property is taxable, and the burden of proof is on the person who claims the exemption.
